# 参与贡献

欢迎通过本仓库的 [Issues](https://github.com/UFOAlastor/koreader_PicaYomi/issues) 反馈问题、提出建议，也可以提交 Pull Request。中英文均可。

- 问题反馈请提供插件版本、KOReader 版本、设备型号、漫画源名称与版本、复现步骤及预期结果。
- 日志和截图请先脱敏，移除账号、密码、Cookie、token 及个人阅读信息。安全漏洞请按 [安全政策](SECURITY.md) 私下报告。
- 尽量让每个 PR 聚焦一个问题，说明行为变化及验证方法。模拟器检查、设备验证和账号验证请分别说明；没有执行的检查请明确标注。
- 漫画源的接口、解析、登录及制作问题请到 [漫画源仓库](https://github.com/UFOAlastor/PicaYomi_MangaSources) 讨论。`bundled/*.pysource` 是生成文件，请修改源代码并通过构建、签名和发布流程更新。

本仓库是经过审核导出的发布快照。维护者会把已接受的修改纳入开发流程，再同步到发布仓库。仓库 CI 只做静态检查，不能代替真实设备、网络与账号验收。

## English

Issues and pull requests in Chinese or English are welcome. Include affected versions, device details, reproduction steps, and validation performed. Remove credentials and personal data from all attachments; report vulnerabilities privately using the [security policy](SECURITY.md).

This repository contains reviewed release snapshots. Maintainers integrate accepted changes through the development and export process. Source adapter changes belong in the [source repository](https://github.com/UFOAlastor/PicaYomi_MangaSources); bundled packages are generated files. CI provides static checks only and does not establish device or account compatibility.
